ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: The council let the planting day go when the fields opened. It fades in a few days. Next spring, make a day of it (kept two years running, it becomes a tradition), or put a planting day on the calendar yourself (in the Calendar, add a new day and keep it as a planting day).
ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.act: Make a planting day next spring

ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: The council left the herd out in the weather. It fades in a few days. Bring them in: a barn with animal beds, or a pen, keeps them sheltered, and next time the council can send people out to bring the herd home.
